content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into lots sold B2B to homebuilders; it does not build or sell homes to consumers."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to homebuyers, with affiliated mortgage financing and lot development."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family detached and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage services."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells detached homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Insurance underwriter for title, mortgage guaranty and commercial lines; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Life insurance, mortgage lending and cemetery businesses; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells detached and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Land, hospitality, club and timber business in Northwest Florida; homebuilding is only a small part of its operations."}]}
